text: {"status":"CONFLICT","claims":[{"text":"Uploading company information classified Internal or above to a personal cloud-storage account is prohibited.","evidence_id":"E1","quote":"Uploading company information classified Internal or above to a personal cloud-storage account, such as a personal Dropbox, personal Google Drive or personal OneDrive, is prohibited."},{"text":"Employees may store Internal information in a personal cloud-storage account when working remotely if the account is protected with multi-factor authentication.","evidence_id":"E2","quote":"Employees may store Internal information in a personal cloud-storage account when working remotely, provided the account is protected with multi-factor authentication."}],"conflict_evidence_ids":["E1","E2"],"conflict_note":"E1 says Internal information in personal cloud storage is prohibited, while E2 allows Internal information in personal cloud storage when working remotely with multi-factor authentication."}
